climbFlightLease20261023.finding: Automatic climb directly issued flyInHeight outside the shared aircraft mutation lease. A retained local climb flag prevented later completed-insertion reuse. Shutdown cleared aircraft drop hold without checking its insertion episode.
implementation: One-shot AIRBORNE_CLIMB acquisition at priority50, below existing braking100/attack300/defence400/landing500. Validate current exact lease before flyInHeight, mark requested only inside that boundary, then immediately release. Refused acquisition leaves flag unset.

Exact current-owner insertion finish clears its own climb flag with aircraft hold. Shutdown checks nonempty exact job episode and actual aircraft locality before clearing hold/flag/episode; stale jobs cannot erase successor aircraft state.
No additional flight worker, persistent lease or guessed original altitude. Existing documented post-drop height remains until mission/controller supplies a later instruction.
